candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Closer intersection entry with shifted ego route and reduced pedestrian influence to focus on signal interaction while preserving ambiguous lane/stop-line relation.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Bias ego to approach the signalized intersection from a slightly different lateral and longitudinal placement to explore robustness of red-light violation triggering under similar light activity, while keeping lane invasion and stop-line crossing unconstrained and module-level responsibility unknown.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Confirm that the modified spawn and destination still require ego to traverse at least one active signalized intersection on Town01.
Verify that multiple traffic lights ahead of ego are active and publish state changes including red during the time ego approaches.
Ensure that pedestrian actors remain near the roadway but are not scripted to force an unavoidable collision with ego prior to any red-light event.
Check that overall weather remains similar to the seed case (no extreme changes that would invalidate comparison of behaviors).
post_execution_validation_rules: Confirm error_json indicates a red-light violation and does not indicate collision or stuck for the run.
Verify that traffic_lights messages around the time of violation include at least one light in red state, with ego in the vicinity of that intersection.
Ensure that final_waypoints and vehicle_status are available and non-zero leading up to the violation time.
Do not enforce any specific lane_invasion outcome; allow missing or contradictory lane invasion labeling as acceptable.
Keep the route–light geometric relationship and stop-line crossing status as nonrequirements; runs where these remain ambiguous are still valid.
uncertainty: Whether ego crosses the physical stop-line before or during the red phase is intentionally not constrained and may be unobservable.
Lane boundary adherence at the time of the red-light violation may be unknown or inconsistently labeled and is not enforced.
The interplay between slightly altered pedestrian trajectories and ego decision-making remains uncertain and may vary across replays.
Potential internal causes of any red-light violation (e.g., misperceived signal state vs. planning decision vs. control execution) remain unidentified.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
